scenarios.title: A｜前台无法解决
scenarios.setting: 在“投诉升级”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“前台无法解决”。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but unfortunately there’s nothing more I can do from the front desk.

turns.prompt: 关于「投诉升级」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand, but the issue still hasn’t been resolved.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but the issue still hasn’t been resolved.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t been resolved”表示问题到现在还没解决，适合跟进之前已反映的情况。

choices.text: I appreciate your help, but I still need a solution.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate your help, but I still need a solution.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: I understand that you may not be able to authorize it yourself.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand that you may not be able to authorize it yourself.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: So what other options do I have?

feedback.naturalExpression: So what other options do I have?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: Then who can solve this for me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but the issue still hasn’t been resolved.
feedback.explanation: 询问谁能解决问题是合理的；“Who would be able to help with this?”能保持坚定又稍微缓和语气。

turns.text: I’m afraid this is outside what I’m able to approve.

turns.prompt: 你想请前台将未解决的问题交给其他负责人处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is there someone else who could help me with this?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there someone else who could help me with this?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Could this be referred to a supervisor?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could this be referred to a supervisor?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Who would be able to make that decision?

feedback.naturalExpression: Who would be able to make that decision?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Could you please escalate this for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you please escalate this for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: I can contact the duty manager for you.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, please. I’d appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, please. I’d appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Thank you. I’d like to speak with them if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’d like to speak with them if possible.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

scenarios.title: B｜要求见经理
scenarios.setting: 在“投诉升级”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“要求见经理”。

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店安排负责人进一步沟通，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could I speak to the manager, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I speak to the manager, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: I’d like to speak with the duty manager.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to speak with the duty manager.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Would it be possible to speak to a supervisor?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to speak to a supervisor?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: I think I’d like to discuss this with a manager.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’d like to discuss this with a manager.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Call your manager.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could I speak to the manager, please?
feedback.explanation: “Call your manager”是命令句；“Could I speak to the manager?”表达同样诉求，更便于合作处理。

turns.text: Of course. May I ask what this is regarding?

turns.prompt: 关于「投诉升级」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s about an issue with my room that hasn’t been resolved.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s about an issue with my room that hasn’t been resolved.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t been resolved”表示问题到现在还没解决，适合跟进之前已反映的情况。

choices.text: I’ve already spoken to the front desk several times about the problem.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve already spoken to the front desk several times about the problem.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve already”强调这一步已经做过，能在沟通中确认进度。

choices.text: It’s regarding a charge that I’m disputing.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s regarding a charge that I’m disputing.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I’d prefer to explain the full situation directly to the manager.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d prefer to explain the full situation directly to the manager.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

turns.text: Certainly. The manager is assisting another guest at the moment.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: That’s fine. How long do you think the wait will be?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. How long do you think the wait will be?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Could you ask them to speak with me when they’re available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you ask them to speak with me when they’re available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Can I wait here?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I wait here?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Could the manager call my room instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could the manager call my room instead?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

turns.text: It should only be about ten minutes.

turns.prompt: 关于「投诉升级」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s fine. I’ll wait. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’ll wait. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay. Please let them know I’m waiting.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Please let them know I’m waiting.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

scenarios.title: C｜礼貌但坚定地坚持要求
scenarios.setting: 在“投诉升级”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“礼貌但坚定地坚持要求”。

turns.text: I understand your concern, but I’m afraid we’re unable to offer a full refund.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand your position, but I don’t think the current solution is fair.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand your position, but I don’t think the current solution is fair.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I appreciate that, but I’d still like you to reconsider.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate that, but I’d still like you to reconsider.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: I understand the policy, but I believe this situation is different.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand the policy, but I believe this situation is different.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I’m afraid I’m not satisfied with that solution.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid I’m not satisfied with that solution.
feedback.explanation: “I’m afraid”引出可能让对方失望或为难的信息，是缓和语气的说法，不一定表示害怕。

choices.text: No, that’s unacceptable.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I understand your position, but I don’t think the current solution is fair.
feedback.explanation: “unacceptable”明确表示不能接受，不是语法问题；接着说明可接受的方案，协商才有方向。

turns.text: The best we can currently offer is a $30 credit.

turns.prompt: 关于「投诉升级」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Given what happened, I was hoping for a more appropriate solution.

feedback.naturalExpression: Given what happened, I was hoping for a more appropriate solution.
feedback.explanation: 用过去式开头缓和请求，表达试探或期待，而不是要求对方必须照办。

choices.text: I appreciate the offer, but it doesn’t really address the inconvenience I experienced.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate the offer, but it doesn’t really address the inconvenience I experienced.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Could you explain why a larger refund isn’t possible?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain why a larger refund isn’t possible?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Is there any flexibility in what you can offer?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any flexibility in what you can offer?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

turns.text: I may be able to increase the credit to $60.

turns.prompt: 你想了解退换或退款的处理办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Would you be able to refund that amount instead of giving me a credit?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you be able to refund that amount instead of giving me a credit?
feedback.explanation: “instead of”引出想替换掉的选项，让对方清楚比较的是哪两个方案。

choices.text: Could you apply that as a refund to my original payment method?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you apply that as a refund to my original payment method?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: If that’s the maximum you can offer, I’d like written confirmation.

feedback.naturalExpression: If that’s the maximum you can offer, I’d like written confirmation.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I’d still like the matter reviewed if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d still like the matter reviewed if possible.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

turns.text: I can arrange a $60 refund to your original payment method.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: All right. I think that’s a reasonable solution. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. I think that’s a reasonable solution. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Thank you. Could you confirm when the refund will be processed?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. Could you confirm when the refund will be processed?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Okay. I’d appreciate written confirmation as well.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’d appreciate written confirmation as well.
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。
